crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
and you shall teach them diligently to your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you…
You shall eat no leavened bread with it. You shall eat unleavened bread with it seven days, even the bread of…
but his delight is in Yahweh’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,
so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind…
Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

translations.web: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat.
translations.bsb: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.
translations.kjv: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
translations.asv: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that may ye eat.
